notes: CXO_tc_wt macro (verbatim) for weighted case-time-control analysis: removes discordant cases, computes weights with PROC SUMMARY, and fits weighted conditional logistic regression for ex and ex_tc. Sample data are 5 case + 4 time-control patients' rows drawn from the repo's Data/sampdata_scenario01.csv; a caller data step and %CXO_tc_wt invocation were added. options obs=100 caps the captured run.
